cues.headline: GOAL! Niko Blackwood!
cues.body: Ashvale Town score! It's Ashvale Town 1–0 Harbor City.

cues.headline: What a pass!
cues.body: Goran Esterby just played the hardest pass of the match so far.

cues.headline: Kasim Thorne scores!
cues.body: Get in! Ashvale Town 1–1 Harbor City.

cues.headline: Harbor City are on top
cues.body: Harbor City are on top: forcing Ashvale Town into 5 losses in their own half, winning the ball back in the opposition half 2 times and playing 5 progressive passes in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 6.6 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: It's in! Quin Isard!
cues.body: Quin Isard finds the net for Ashvale Town: Ashvale Town 2–1 Harbor City. The broken game finally produced a goal. It came 7 seconds after Ashvale Town won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: Harbor City turn the screw
cues.body: Harbor City are calling the shots now: recovering the ball 2 times in the final third and leaving Ashvale Town just 1.8 passes per defensive action in the last 5 minutes. Just what Harbor City need while they're behind.

cues.headline: It's all gone wild
cues.body: The ball is changing hands 7.2 times a minute. Neither side can calm it down.

cues.headline: GOAL! Goran Esterby!
cues.body: Harbor City score! It's Ashvale Town 2–2 Harbor City. The broken game finally produced a goal. It came 5 seconds after Harbor City won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: Hugo Okafor scores!
cues.body: Get in! Ashvale Town 3–2 Harbor City. It had been coming: Ashvale Town were in control.

recap.headline: Full time: Ashvale Town 3–2 Harbor City
recap.summary: A deserved win for Ashvale Town.
